# Vendored Twimg subprocess provenance

`download_twitter_media.py` is copied byte-for-byte from this repository's
legacy implementation at `src/dler_kun/vendor/twimg/download_twitter_media.py`
(commit `c5083f4`, verified by Git history on 2026-10-16). It is retained as an
external subprocess and has not been modified during migration.

The repository's MIT license applies; the original vendor inventory is recorded
in `NOTICE`. The matching license text is included beside the copied tool.
Runtime dependencies remain those already declared by the project. Do not treat
this tool as evidence that any particular hostname belongs to its backend.
